# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Prufyx discussions should be precise, respectful, and useful. We welcome disagreement backed by evidence and expect participants to:

- critique ideas and results, not people;
- disclose uncertainty and correct mistakes openly;
- respect privacy, security boundaries, and confidential information;
- avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, sexualized conduct, and sustained disruption;
- help create a space where people with different experience levels can contribute.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to [hello@prufyx.com](mailto:hello@prufyx.com). Do not use a public issue. Maintainers may edit or remove content, restrict participation, or exclude participants when needed to protect the community.

Reports will be handled as privately as practical. Retaliation against a reporter or participant in an investigation is not acceptable.
